title: Install dependencies & local build
description: Install PHP and JS dependencies and verify local dev server. Run in PowerShell: `composer install`, `npm install`, `php artisan key:generate`, then start dev stack with `composer run dev` (or `pwsh .\scripts\dev-start.ps1`).

title: Run unit & feature tests
description: Run backend tests to ensure no regressions: `php artisan test`. Fix failing tests or skip only with documented justification.

title: Build production assets locally
description: Produce a production asset build to validate bundling and hashed outputs: `npm run build`. Confirm output in `public/build` (or configured build path).

title: Smoke test theme & navigation
description: Manually verify theme and navigation across main views — open app in browser (http://127.0.0.1:8000) and check header, responsive behavior and theme variables in `resources/js/theme.js` and `resources/views/livewire/layout/navigation.blade.php`. Capture screenshots of desktop/mobile states for PR.

title: Smoke test charts and real-time flows
description: Verify charts render and real-time updates work by exercising pages that use Livewire charts and `WaterQualityCreated` event; run `php artisan reverb:start` and open dashboards that consume `water-quality-data-created` channel. Confirm no console errors.

title: Asset handling — fonts & images
description: Identify large fonts/images under `resources/fonts` and `public/assets`; optimize (subsetting fonts, compress images) and add to Git LFS if >5MB. Rebuild assets after changes.

title: Update README and developer docs
description: Document frontend redesign notes, new dev-start steps, and asset handling in `README.md` and `docs/WEB_DESIGN.md`; include commands to start dev stack and troubleshooting tips for PowerShell.

title: CI pipeline: add frontend build & tests
description: Update GitHub Actions workflow to run `composer install`, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, and `php artisan test` on PRs. Ensure caching for node_modules and composer cache.

title: Accessibility smoke tests
description: Run automated accessibility checks (Lighthouse/axe/pa11y) against key pages (navigation, dashboard, charts) and document issues to fix.

title: End-to-end (E2E) tests
description: Add or run E2E tests exercising login, navigation, theme toggle, and chart live updates using Cypress or Playwright; ensure tests run in CI or are flake-resistant.

title: Verify backend compatibility & models
description: Confirm no API or model contract changes break backend flows: check `app/Livewire/*`, `app/Services/*`, and routes. Run targeted feature tests that post sensor data to `POST /store-water-quality-data`.

title: Confirm broadcast & event channels
description: Ensure `water-quality-data-created` channel and event payloads remain compatible; test broadcast locally with sample events and confirm Livewire/Reverb clients receive them.

title: Prepare PR & required description
description: Create PR from `feat/frontend-redesign` into `main` and include the summary, testing steps, screenshots and rollout notes. Use `gh pr create` or the GitHub UI and paste the prepared PR body.

title: Final merge checklist
description: Before merging ensure: CI checks passed, at least one approval, no failing tests, no pending migrations, and changelog updated. Merge using GH UI or `gh pr merge` once green.

title: Post-merge steps & monitoring
description: After merge, run production build/deploy steps (`npm run build`, `php artisan migrate --force`) and monitor logs and real-time channels for regressions for 24–48 hours. Prepare rollback plan if needed.
